title: Four steps from curiosity to conversation
subtitle: Labora is built around what actually gets a professor to reply.

s1.title: Search the scholarly record
s1.body: Type a research interest and a university — or a researcher's name. We surface people who are actively publishing on it.
s1.b1: Results drawn from an open scholarly database
s1.b2: Filter by university, sort by recent activity

s2.title: Understand their work
s2.body: Read a plain-English summary, a recent finding and questions worth asking — then skim the papers themselves.
s2.b1: Summaries written for someone new to the field
s2.b2: Recent and most-cited papers at a glance

s3.title: Write an email that gets read
s3.body: Draft it yourself, then check it. We highlight flattery, boilerplate and vagueness — and never write the email for you.

s4.title: Follow up and track
s4.body: Log who you contacted, get well-timed follow-ups, and keep every lead in one place.
s4.b1: Two follow-up drafts and calendar reminders
s4.b2: An outreach tracker that keeps score

ctaMatch: Or let AI find your fit
